title: Warm Velvety Egyptian Banana Fritters
description: A festive Egyptian dish featuring fried ripe bananas, this malty and velvety treat is perfect for special occasions, and is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and malt powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, and honey.
Add the sliced bananas to the sugar mixture and toss until they are well coated.
Add the banana mixture to the flour mixture and stir until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the banana mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the fritters with sesame seeds and serve warm.
